name.zh: 晓学园代表在宴会挑衅

periods.summary: Akatsuki representatives openly attend the banquet despite their attack on Hagun. Sara tries to force Ikki to become her nude model, Rinna and Charlotte remove her, and Yui Tatara attempts to poison Shizuku before national-class fighters pressure Tatara to back down.
periods.cause: Akatsuki can rely on Tsukikage's information control and is willing to act brazenly in front of other representatives.
periods.process: Sara tears Ikki's shirt and is kicked unconscious by Shizuku. Tatara then reveals her malice by hiding poisoned razor blades in food for Shizuku. Ikki blocks it, Tatara summons her Device, Moroboshi stops Ikki from starting a brawl, Kaga eats the poisoned chicken, Kiriko restrains Tatara, and Kuraudo threatens her for interfering with Ikki.
periods.outcome: Tatara withdraws, Ikki and Moroboshi recognize each other's warrior mindset, and Ikki gains a clearer sense of the national stage's danger.
periods.significance: Introduces several Akatsuki members and top national rivals while showing that Seven Stars will include underworld-level hostility.
